summary: Activity heatmap where each day is nine sub-pixels, so intensity shows as brightness and density; switching metric flips cells in a wave.

methods.description: Switches the metric: `0` for sessions, `1` for tokens. Other values are ignored.

keyboard.action: In the metric switch: select and focus the other metric.

accessibility: The metric switch is a `role="radiogroup"` with `aria-label="Metric"`; its two buttons have `role="radio"` and `aria-checked`. Only the checked radio is in the tab order; arrow keys move the selection.
The canvas has `role="img"` with an `aria-label` giving the total and the longest streak for the current metric.
The streak summary above the grid is an `aria-live="polite"` region.
The per-day tooltip appears on pointer hover only.
motion: With reduced motion, switching metric replaces the cells at once instead of flipping them in a diagonal wave; click ripples still play.
notes: The data is generated demo data, derived deterministically from each date, with weekdays busier than weekends. There is no attribute for real data.
The grid ends at today and shows one 12px column per week, from 8 to 40 weeks depending on width. The canvas is 86px tall.

data.note: The daily activity counts are generated from each date; nothing can be set.
